meta.equal_compute: Every compared run has the same budget (search seconds, QUICK, RECOMMENDED only) and runs alone in its lane's process (SOLVER_PARALLEL=0). Production also runs the second route search (PyVRP); it is off here (SOLVER_PYVRP=off) so that every run gets the same single-core search.
meta.honesty: Distances are HAVERSINE estimates (estimated km). Plans are the best found in the time given, not proven optimal; only E5's oracle proves optimality, on the instances it enumerates completely. Cash is OMR (costing.truck_day_costs); solver penalties are ARTIFICIAL and never added to cash.

ivms.source: decision_support/data/ivms_aggregates.json: aggregates of the IVMS report (Feb-Mar 2026) and the 13 Oct truck evidence

unloading_gap.basis: 13 Oct GPS evidence: time on site per chain, visit-weighted median of 1 - p25/p50

whatif.reload: Reload between loads (trip 2+): 3T 30 min (p25 19, p50 28, p75 40, p90 60); 10T about 30 min (p50 28, p75 about 55, p90 about 80) before daytime trips (SUPPORTED (3T) / SUPPORTED, small n (10T))
whatif.latest_return: Latest return to depot: 10T p50 17:00, p75 18:57, p90 20:07; 3T p50 17:36, p75 18:39, p90 19:22. 3T in October: p50 18:16, p75 19:02, p90 20:20 (58% of days after 18:00). (SUPPORTED)

speed.basis: IVMS MOVING segments, Muscat (MOVING segments >= 1 km and >= 2 min, speed = km / hours <= 130): median km/h 06-18 30.7 (segment-weighted mean of the band medians, n=2978), 18-22 25.71 (n=398), 22-06 21.71 (n=147). Cross-check, 13 Oct truck evidence: Time-of-day factor, trucks, Muscat core: 1.00 except 12-15 about 1.06; 18+ 1.07-1.13 (low n) (INFERRED)

labels.km: estimated km (HAVERSINE: straight line x haversine_multiplier), not road km
labels.time: minutes, trips and trucks: time and capacity, not cash
labels.cash_saved: OMR cash the plan no longer spends without the stop (with - without); positive = saving
labels.move: OMR cash change if the stop rides on another load instead (moved - now); negative = cheaper
labels.future: OMR cash of delivering the stop later: NEXT_DAY_PLAN (exact insertion into the given plan) or PROXY (today's fixed-plan marginal cost of the same stop, reused)

labels.margin: contribution margin: DispatchStop.margin, or an explicit margin_per_case ASSUMPTION; never invented
labels.break_even: OMR per case: deferring pays only if the margin lost is below this, (least cash saved - future cost - 0.1) / cases, the figures the recommendation uses; only with a next-day plan (a PROXY future cost gives none)

assumptions.ride_along: ASSUMPTION: OMR of the stop's extra unloading minutes if it waits for the customer's next regular delivery (0.25 min per case, the 14 Oct benchmark, x driver_cost_per_hour)
assumptions.margin: none given: break-even margins only (stops with DispatchStop.margin use it)

labels.cash: OMR cash cost of the new loads (costing.truck_day_costs via DispatchScenario.truck_days)
labels.penalties: ARTIFICIAL: solver penalties in OMR-equivalent (leaving stops out, preferred windows, early arrival, plan continuity). Not cash; never add them to cash
labels.km: estimated km (HAVERSINE: straight line x haversine_multiplier), not road km
labels.time: minutes, trips and trucks: time and capacity, not cash
labels.cash_saved: OMR cash the plan no longer spends without the stop (with - without); positive = saving
labels.move: OMR cash change if the stop rides on another load instead (moved - now); negative = cheaper
labels.future: OMR cash of delivering the stop later: NEXT_DAY_PLAN (exact insertion into the given plan) or PROXY (today's fixed-plan marginal cost of the same stop, reused)
labels.ride_along: ASSUMPTION: OMR of the stop's extra unloading minutes if it waits for the customer's next regular delivery (0.25 min per case, the 14 Oct benchmark, x driver_cost_per_hour)
labels.margin: contribution margin: DispatchStop.margin, or an explicit margin_per_case ASSUMPTION; never invented
labels.break_even: OMR per case: deferring pays only if the margin lost is below this, (least cash saved - future cost - 0.1) / cases, the figures the recommendation uses; only with a next-day plan (a PROXY future cost gives none)
labels.evidence: IVMS truck GPS (Feb-Mar 2026) and 13 Oct truck evidence aggregates: context, never cash
